description: Convert any photo into a vintage newspaper-style halftone dot print.

faqs.a: The image is divided into a grid; each cell becomes a dot whose size matches the cell's average brightness.
Black dots on a white background, like classic print.
faqs.q: What does the result look like?

faqs.a: The dot-size slider sets the grid spacing from fine (4px) to chunky (24px).
faqs.q: How do I control the look?

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Drag the dot-size slider to preview.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Halftone Effect
